name: Cebu
tagline: Where Christianity came to the Philippines
summary: Cebu is the Philippines' oldest city, where Magellan landed in 1521. Its churches and forts tell that story, the Sinulog festival fills the streets in January, and the island has some of the country's best diving, waterfalls and beaches.
seasonNote: December to May is dry. The Sinulog festival is the third Sunday of January. June to November brings rain and typhoons.
arrival: Mactan-Cebu International Airport is 30 to 60 minutes from the city, with flights from Manila, Singapore, Seoul and Tokyo.
gettingAround: Grab and taxis in the city; buses or a driver to the south of the island.
cashTip: Carry pesos in small notes for jeepneys, tricycles and small shops; ATMs can run dry on islands, so bring enough cash.
foodTip: Cebu lechon (roast pig), puso hanging rice and fresh seafood.
buyTip: Dried mangoes, guitars from Mactan and shell crafts.

connections.note: Via Puerto Princesa or direct seasonal flights.
